answer_1.quote: Our goal is to train abstractive summarization systems that generate both faithful and informative summaries in an end-to-end fashion.

answer_2.quote: Results based on QuestEval , a QA-based factuality metric of high correlation with human judgments... We also report ROUGE-L . Both FactCC and ROUGE-L reasonably correlate with summary factuality as judged by human.

answer_4.quote: We recruit the two human annotators for our summary error study, as well as another experienced annotator, to evaluate summary informativeness and factual consistency.
answer_4.guideline: Please first read the article and the baseline summary and then compare each system summary against the baseline summary based on informativeness and factual consistency.
